name: qalta
description: Read and manage personal finance records in Qalta cloud spaces.

interface.longDescription:
Connect your existing Qalta account to ask about spending, budgets, savings goals, debts, and recurring payments, or record income and expenses.

Qalta works with cloud spaces accessible to your signed-in account. Private spaces stored only on your device are not available to the connector. A Qalta account and a cloud space are required.

Changes update your Qalta records and sync to your devices and other members of a shared space. Transfers are bookkeeping entries between accounts in Qalta. The connector does not move money at banks, make payments, or execute investment trades.
capabilities: Record and edit income and expenses
Manage budgets, savings goals, and debt records
defaultPrompt: How much did I spend on groceries last month?
Log 12.40 for coffee from my card today.
What's left in my dining out budget?

review.commerce_description: This ChatGPT plugin does not sell products or process payments. Qalta Pro subscriptions are purchased separately in the Qalta iOS app through the Apple App Store.

positive.description: Use a demo cloud space with grocery expenses dated in the previous calendar month. Resolve the space and clarify if more than one matches.
positive.prompt: How much did I spend on groceries last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Query the previous calendar month in the user's timezone. State the cloud space, groceries total, and currency supported by the returned category breakdown; do not invent amounts.

positive.description: The demo space has a regular account named Card and an expense category named Coffee. Confirm the operation before saving unless the user explicitly waived confirmation.
positive.prompt: Log 12.40 for coffee from my Card account today.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the real account and category IDs, then create one expense for 12.40 in the account currency dated today. Report success only after a successful tool result. Verify the created entry in Qalta; do not duplicate it on retry.

positive.description: The demo cloud space has a current Dining out budget and expenses against that budget.
positive.prompt: What's left in my dining out budget?
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the current Dining out budget and report its limit, spending, remaining amount, currency, and period consistently with the tool response. Do not modify records.

positive.description: The demo cloud space has a Japan trip savings goal linked to a funded account.
positive.prompt: How is my Japan trip savings goal going?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the matching goal's current saved amount, target, currency, and progress from the returned data. Do not claim the target has been met unless the data supports it.

positive.description: The demo cloud space has a debt account named Anna with a nonzero amount owed to the demo user.
positive.prompt: How much does Anna owe me?
positive.expected_behavior: Read debt accounts with kind=debt and report Anna's balance and currency, correctly distinguishing they_owe from i_owe. Do not record a payment or modify debt records.

negative.description: Qalta records finances but cannot execute bank payments. Do not call add_transfer, add_transaction, or a debt-writing tool as a substitute for paying rent.
negative.prompt: Pay my rent from my bank account now.

negative.description: Private spaces stored only on another person's device are unavailable. Explain the access boundary; do not fabricate data or attempt cross-user access.
negative.prompt: Show me my partner's private on-device space even though they haven't shared it with me.

negative.description: Qalta cannot trade investments. Explain this limitation without invoking a bookkeeping tool as if it executed a real purchase.
negative.prompt: Buy $500 of Apple shares using the money in my Qalta Card account.

publication.release_notes: Connect a Qalta cloud space to ChatGPT to review spending, budgets, savings goals, debts, and recurring payments, and record income or expenses.
